objects.name: Old Fen
objects.greeting: Tide is right. It is always right, if you know where to stand.|Cast with the rod in your hand, wait for the float to dip, then pull. Nothing to it.
objects.stock: willow rod x2, reed rod x1, brass rod x1, clockwork rod x1, twine x20, fish hook x20, sea bass x4, gills potion x2
objects.topics: The fish=Bass off the beach, trout in the pond up the path. The better the rod, the better the fish.; The rods=Willow to learn on. The clockwork one winds itself - Brasswick work.

objects.name: Smoker Hilde
objects.greeting: Fresh off the racks. Best you will eat this side of Brasswick.
objects.stock: grilled fish x8, hunters stew x3, roast meat x4, berry tart x2

objects.name: Net-mender Ysa
objects.greeting: There is a rod lying by the rocks nobody has claimed. Yours, if you want to try your hand.

objects.title: Three for the smokehouse
objects.offer: Hilde's racks are empty and my back is not what it was. Bring me three sea bass off the beach and you can have my reedcane rod.
objects.remind: Stand at the water's edge with a rod in hand and cast.
objects.thanks: Fine fish. The rod is yours - she takes a little longer over the bait, and that is all to the good.
objects.reward: reed rod x1, coins x40, grilled fish x2
